title: Important email lands in spam

character.name: Hafsa
character.personality: annoyed, almost missed a supplier quote

symptom: A supplier's emails keep going to the Junk folder
user_description: A supplier we use every week keeps ending up in my Junk folder. I nearly missed their quote today.

options.text: Turn off spam filtering for the whole company
options.why: Exposes everyone to phishing and spam to fix one sender. Far out of proportion.

options.text: Tell her to check Junk every day
options.why: A workaround that depends on her remembering. It does not fix why the mail is caught.

options.text: Mark it as Not Junk and add the sender to her safe senders, and if it keeps happening report it to the mail administrators so the cause can be checked
options.why: Marking and allowing the sender helps straight away. Reporting repeat cases lets administrators find the reason, such as a sender with weak email authentication.
Stops all mail from a supplier she needs. The opposite of the goal.

hints: Who decides what goes into Junk, and how can you tell it what is wrong?
Is a quick fix enough, or should the cause be found too?
Who can see why mail from this sender is being caught?
real_world_tip: Ask for the sender's exact address. Allowing a whole domain is riskier than allowing one address.
